label: D1 reward-received after choosing a1 (strongest after a1 -> S2 rare rewarded)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2), and almost only when the previous trial chose a1 (prev_action==2 carries 1.4% of mass; prev_action -1 is the window-start D1 where the earlier choice lies outside the window) and was rewarded (in_rew==1 carries 92% of mass). The predicate D1 & prev_action!=2 & prev_reward==1 captures ~91% of activation mass (dev) but precision is only ~0.30: within this context it is silent on many steps, especially long streaks of a1 -> S1 common rewarded trials where the a1 policy is already saturated. Magnitude is largest after a1 -> S2 rare rewarded trials (D1 & prev_action==1 & prev_reward==1 & prev_common==0: precision 0.86, 17% of activations but 44% of mass), i.e. where the model-based agent should switch to a2. Policy logit at D1 being moderately pro-a1 (choice 2.8-8) also correlates; firing rate also falls at the start and end of episodes. No observed-variable predicate tried (rare transition, recent reward history, value bands) gave clean precision. Recorded predicate uses only observed variables.
